gaps.lead: I can't wait for the holidays to start.
gaps.explanation: look forward TO + -ing: the 'to' is a preposition.

gaps.lead: Nobody else in the team runs as fast as Maya.
gaps.explanation: nobody runs faster = she is the fastest runner.

gaps.lead: 'Have you seen my keys anywhere?' he asked us.
gaps.sentence: He asked us ___ his keys anywhere.
gaps.explanation: if/whether + subject + backshifted verb: whether we had seen.

gaps.lead: The garage is servicing my car tomorrow morning.
gaps.explanation: Arranged service: have/get something done — having my car serviced.

gaps.lead: 'I've never been to Asia,' she told me.
gaps.sentence: She told me that ___ to Asia.
gaps.explanation: Present perfect shifts to past perfect in reported speech.

gaps.lead: Pay claims must be submitted before the end of the month.
gaps.sentence: You have ___ your pay claims before the end of the month.
gaps.explanation: 'Must be submitted' becomes 'you have to put in your claims'.
